parameters: It's... draining. The flow goes in,
That's not natural. Leylines don't just *leak*.
Two years ago, I felt the first one. Far to the north.
I thought I was imagining it.
Each a little closer. Each a little larger.
The Academy teaches what is known, Kaelen.
This is not known. So I left to learn it.
Did you tell the Council? The Royal Mages could—
The Council is... aware that mages talk
Isolde touches the crack with the tip of her staff.
It shrinks... but does not close.
Magic flow is the blood of this world.
Something is poisoning it. Through cracks like this one.
...I'm beginning to believe there are people who would
welcome this. Who might even be helping it along.
You set yourself one year. You are seven months in.
But this is more important than a license!
The world will still be broken in five months, Kaelen.
You want to be the number one mage. I know.
You told the entire Academy. Twice. At graduation.
It was *one* time. It just echoed.
Number one of *what*, Kaelen? Of Nova?
The world is far larger than this kingdom,
and far larger than any of us.
...I'll finish the exam. And then I'll go.
Good. Keep the shard. Don't show it to anyone
Never trust a teacher who answers that question.
A mage of the capital, then. It does not matter.
The second figure draws the violet smoke into a glass vial.
The Age of Heroes will return,
and this time, it will be *ours*.
Everyone thinks you vanished, you know.
Rumor says you live in a tower and talk to owls.
Only one owl. And he rarely answers.
Why did you retire, Professor? You were the best
teacher at the Academy. Everyone says so.
Everyone says a great many things.
I needed to listen to something
...That's a very teacher way of not answering.
Thank you. I practiced it for years.
Skyreach Hill. On a clear night you can see
Actually... I found something today. On my mission.
Hollow Farm, by the pond. A wolf whose mana
flowed backwards. Fire sank into it like water.
When it died, it melted, and left *this*.
Tell me, Kaelen. Can you read the flow?
Mana flow? That's third-year theory. Of course I can.
\C[6]Mana Sight\C[0]: threads of mana glimmer in the dark,
Follow them, and examine the place where they go wrong.
